title: The meeting-room QR login — question explanation
learningObjective: Evaluate QR-linked destinations before authentication or payment
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A QR code on a meeting-room poster promises access to the conference Wi-Fi. After scanning, it opens a sign-in page on a domain unrelated to the venue.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Evaluate QR-linked destinations before authentication or payment
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option C: Check the displayed URL, close the page, and ask facilities/IT for the official network instructions. Verify the destination and obtain connection details through an approved internal source.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: A different browser still submits credentials to the same untrusted site. Option B: The physical location does not validate the QR destination or page operator. Option D: Sharing credentials exposes the coworker’s account and does not validate the page.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Do not enter credentials. Confirm the poster with facilities or IT and use the authorized network onboarding process. QR codes conceal destinations; assess the actual URL before authenticating.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: QR codes conceal destinations; assess the actual URL before authenticating.
